{{Quote|Listen close, got to talk quick. Found one of your people at a Nova Blade slave auction. Taken from here on Dantooine. Got her out, but... she didn't make it. Came here with her last request: save the others. Gave a location. Caves. To the east. Simple base, few guards. Move silent, strike fast. Save the ones you can. Last part was a little strange. "Beware of Hugo".|Xeelksidlo speaks with the Alliance Commander|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Xeelksidlo''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] trader in the criminal underworld. She tried to rescue an unidentified female that worked for one of the warring factions in the [[third Galactic War]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] and who was supposed to be sold off at a [[Nova Blades|Nova Blade]]-[[Slavery/Legends|slave]] auction. The unnamed woman did not make it safely back to the base but Xeelksidlo managed to relay her last words. The Rodian informed [[Alliance Commander|The Commander]] - who had allied the [[Eternal Alliance]] with one of the factions - that more captives were in need of saving near the Eastern caves. She considered the warning regarding Hugo as a little strange.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Xeelskidlo first appears<ref name="TOR" /> in Update 5.10.3, released on [[June 4]], [[2019]],<ref name="5.10.3 Date">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20190604|text=Game Update 5.10.3 "The Dantooine Incursion" is Live!}}</ref> for [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. In the game, she is identified as "Underworld Trader Xeelksidlo".<ref name="TOR" />

As both the heroic mission "Beware of Hugo" is available to players of either class and Xeelskidlo can be found in both factions' Dantooine bases, this article assumes only that she did talk with the Outlander and makes no assumption as to which base they met in or which faction the Outlander supported.<ref name="TOR" />
